name: Marriage Between Cousins
overview: Scripture demonstrates that marriage within close kinship, including between cousins, was practiced and permitted in the Old Testament, as seen in God’s instructions for Isaac and Jacob to marry within their extended family (Genesis 24:4; 28:2). While Leviticus 18:6 prohibits uncovering the nakedness of near kin, this law primarily addresses prohibitions against incestuous relationships rather than all familial marriages. Additionally, Numbers 36:6 allows daughters to marry within the tribe of their father, emphasizing the preservation of family lineage. Ultimately, Proverbs 18:22 affirms the blessing of finding a wife, underscoring marriage as a good gift from the Lord.
